record.title: Synthetic comparison of methods
record.abstract: The objective was to compare method A with method B. We used a randomized simulation with the Toy dataset. Method A achieved 80% accuracy and method B achieved 70% accuracy. The study was limited to synthetic data. We conclude that method A performed better in this simulation.
